source.interpretation: Processed intensity already dedispersed near archive DM, not raw voltage. Time axis ms per current CHIME tutorial and 0.98304 ms sampling; historical tutorial incorrectly labels microseconds. Use extent (origin upper, official plotting) and monotonic axis to map rows; independently compare row means to spec in both orders if compatible. Report mismatch/ambiguity; no refit absolute DM from cutout.

retina.native_admission: Native narrowband ON/OFF/REPEAT_ON/REPEAT_OFF scorer cannot be given single FRB spectrum; no fabricated roles or resize. Separate exact R14 temporal scorer + new mask-aware broad-band spectral adapter. No promotion to production.
retina.mask: Record per-channel and time counts, whole masked rows, partial rows, nonfinite type, mask contiguous run lengths, comparison to catalog flag_frac. Never fill NaNs or infer missing data as noise. Use all-time finite rows for unshifted time-profile; retain raw mask hash.
retina.spectral: 64 fixed contiguous 256-channel bins with valid count weights; 4 fixed equal-width physical frequency bands; edge bins 0..5 and 32..37 for diagnostic baseline/RMS only, not independent background. Compare archived fitted model on common finite cells, report residual descriptively (same data fit, not holdout). Record dimensions of all arrays; don't use calibrated_wfall with wrong time axis.
retina.dispersion: Residual DM grid [-2,-1,-.5,-.25,0,.25,.5,1,2] pc cm^-3. Relative delay ms=4.148808*dDM*((f_MHz/1000)^-2-.8^-2). Interpolate native channels, require finite neighbors, no wrap, retain sample count by time. Peak/edge RMS descriptive, not p-value or new absolute DM. Mirror requires reversing time and sign of residual correction; compare profiles and counts; if axis ambiguity, skip physical frequency claims.
retina.inverse: Exact frozen R14 score on full 38-point finite-row mean and 4 bands when available, mirror check D antisymmetry and Q parity; original thresholds not calibrated for real FRB. Hide fixed windows 11:16 and 22:27 (mirror pair), fit F/R/S models on all other points; rank only on observed loss, retain all candidates, compare held measured samples (not latent truth) and linear interpolation; mirrored replay compare all directions. No unique cause.

outrigger.search: Reacquire pinned CSV, join exact normalized TNS names to public Catalog2 pinned pages (max 10 pages), inspect all 83 official Outrigger event API detail endpoints for explicit paired-data links and plot keys, no guessing file paths. Record per-event failures and direct links to possible HDF5/FITS/baseband/visibility data; images and rows not waveforms. Metadata-only matches not pair admission.
outrigger.admission: Require two separately identified site arrays, common event ID, UTC/time reference, frequency grid, clock/geometric delay calibration, and independent noise witness for full R15E. A second science telescope is not automatically a noise witness. No inferred synchronized arrays from plots or catalog. Public endpoint search not exhaustive archive access; no contacting custodians automatically.

spiral: Five canonical axes; origin→mirror→model replay→source→return, hashes of actual deltas; preserve mask/instrument, residual dispersion, astrophysical pulse, common noise, hypothetical carrier; no physical retrocausality, no automatic veto or production change.
